risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis (361) and flat yield curve create hostile macro backdrop; ABT earnings in 50 days adds moderate event risk but does not constitute immediate binary threat.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), Ichimoku TK cross-up, AO cross-up, and OBV rising signal short-term momentum reversal with price near support (107.03) offering defined risk entry in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below 200-EMA and 50-SMA with MACD bearish, stochastic/Williams %R overbought (exhaustion risk), no systematic strategy trigger, zero fundamental conviction, and hostile macro (VIX crisis, flat yield curve) make this a weak-quality entry with elevated pullback probability into earnings.
